implementationScope: package-only progressive packed RGB8 finalization plus explicit 24-bit CoreGraphics materialization with codec-owned pixel payload authority and framework-private operation allocation left unknown
requiredInvariants: All v1 packed-finalization transport binding, RGB8 layout, color classification, transfer charge, backing reuse and terminal reclaim invariants remain unchanged.
DecodedImage materialization creates one explicit tight 24-bit malloc-owned RGB payload with bytesPerRow == width*3, alphaInfo none and an sRGB CoreGraphics color space.
The custom CGDataProvider exposes bytes identical to the packed RGB8 value and the DecodedImage preserves sourceColorProfile absent.
The known pixel-payload coexistence during materialization is exactly packed RGB8 bytes plus one provider copy: 897 + 897 = 1794 bytes for the retained source.
The materializer resource ledger retains zero codec-owned bytes after transfer and keeps transferredOutput exactly 897 bytes with codecOwnedRGB8 layout authority.

Core Graphics CGDataProvider/CGImage wrapper allocation is not controlled by ImageCraft; operationPeak must be unknown(frameworkPrivateOperationAllocation), never a bounded zero or payload-only value.
This evidence proves a package-internal DecodedImage representation seam, not a fully bounded public independent decoder backend.
